# name-kill corpus (kit issue #2208): ONE list pinning both detectors.
# <deny|allow><TAB><one shell command line>. hook-pretool-pkill-guard.sh --strict-name-kill and the name-kill scan in
# maint/kit-writer-check.sh must give the same verdict for every line (hook-pretool-pkill-guard.test.sh and
# kit-writer-check.test.sh both read this file). Single-line commands only; no line may be a comment.
deny	pkill -f foo
deny	pkill -x foo
deny	pkill -f [f]oo
deny	pkill foo
deny	killall python3
deny	sudo -n killall python3
deny	make && pkill -f x
deny	FOO=1 /usr/bin/pkill -9 loop
deny	timeout 5 pkill -f loop
deny	x=$(pkill -f loop)
deny	bash -c 'pkill -f foo'
deny	if pkill -f foo; then :; fi
deny	kill -9 -1
deny	kill -1
deny	kill -- -1
deny	kill -TERM -1
deny	kill -s KILL -1
deny	pgrep -f loop | xargs kill
deny	pidof loop | xargs kill -9
deny	pidof loop | xargs -r kill
deny	kill $(pgrep -f loop)
deny	kill $(pidof loop)
deny	kill `pidof loop`
deny	pgrep -f loop | while read p; do kill $p; done
allow	kill 1234
allow	kill -9 4321
allow	kill -TERM "$pid"
allow	kill $!
allow	kill -- -12345
allow	kill -0 $$
allow	echo "never use pkill -f on loops"
allow	echo skill killing-time pkillx
allow	pkill_helper() { :; }
allow	grep -Eq 'pkill' file
allow	pgrep -x loop
allow	jobs -p | xargs kill
allow	timeout 30 ./run-load.sh
allow	source hook-pretool-pkill-guard.sh
allow	STDIN='{"command":"pkill -f foo"}'
